title: Test ordered lunar-mansion features beyond the f69v count
statement: In a visual count on the Beinecke f69v scan I counted 28 green-ended radial bars, 14 dark blue and 14 paler, arranged alternately. I counted the caps themselves and used no proposed glyph values. This was an unblinded single-observer check because Herrmann's expected count was known. Scan at https://collections.library.yale.edu/iiif/2/1006199/pct:6,15,27,61/1000,/0/default.jpg. Herrmann (2017), section 3.3, reports candidate Pahlavi names for 20 mansions and leaves the correspondences unpublished at https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.01634. Greater Bundahishn II.2 enumerates 28 asterisms under twelve constellations in Anklesaria's translation at https://www.avesta.org/mp/grb1.htm. A 1333–34 Arabic astronomical diagram in Bodleian MS Bodl. Or. 133, ff. 117b–118a, also places 28 mansions in a concentric band. The scans show named sectors with variable groups of red dots and several inner astronomical bands, compared with the alternating bars and surrounding text on f69v. The two Bodleian scans are https://iiif.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/iiif/canvas/6021232e-d3e1-4fcb-b57c-9bfb88b8b69f.json and https://iiif.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/iiif/canvas/99500391-88eb-4eb2-83f8-dd5e0a620368.json. See also figure 2.22 at https://press.uchicago.edu/books/hoc/HOC_V2_B1/HOC_Volume2_Book1_chapter2.pdf. A fourteenth-century English manuscript, Countway Library MS 20, ff. 187v–188r, includes a Latin text and table of 28 mansions in the Jordanus catalogue at https://ptolemaeus.badw.de/jordanus/ms/26. Thus the count is compatible with all three traditions and the tested concentric motif has an Arabic counterpart. On f67v2 I see a four-sided center with a swirl and four surrounding words, consistent with the layout Herrmann describes in section 3.4. The visible geometry does not identify a fire or a rite. Scan at https://collections.library.yale.edu/manifests/oid/2002046/canvas/1006195. No independent blinded comparison has yet established a tradition-specific match.
check: Have independent readers mask captions and provenance and code a fixed set of visual features on matched images. For a label comparison, transcribe the radial loci before seeing candidate names. Freeze each tradition's named sequence, allowed tokenization and alignments, including rotation and direction, then compare prediction of an ordered sequence with frequency- and length-matched controls. The shared count of 28 earns no support for any particular tradition.
